items.title: Jim Hall — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: I think Mary Ann Topper was managing Michel as well as me, and she put it together.

ctx.x: …and the Shearing. And now you’ve got this thing going with Petrucciani, who’s a very different flavor.

Yeah. I think Mary Ann Topper was managing Michel as well as me, and she put it together. I’m trying to remember if I had ever heard him play at all but… As you know, he had… I don’t know the technical term, but it was glass bone disease. He had no calcium. And he got about this high. I don’t think he made it to age 30, even. And we had a guy with us on the road to carry Michel. And I just admired him so much. And he had special foot pedals that, you know, that clamp on and he, so he could reach them with his…
